description: The Pinterest growth playbook for 2026 — Pinterest as a visual search engine where keyword-optimized, fresh, vertical pins compound into evergreen traffic. Uses the PINS framework. Reads brand-profile + voice-builder first. The agent drafts pins + SEO copy + schedule; designs come from the image skills; WoopSocial schedules/publishes pins; metrics come from native Pinterest Analytics; nothing is fabricated. Pairs with social-seo and content-recycling.

evals.name: search_engine_not_social
evals.input: How do I grow on Pinterest?
expect: Frames Pinterest as a visual SEARCH engine, not a social feed — optimise for discoverability over time and outbound clicks, not in-the-moment engagement
Notes discovery is keyword/relevance-driven (small accounts can win), so followers matter far less than keyword structure and fresh pin designs
Introduces the PINS framework (Position for search, Images that stop + signal, New designs consistently, Send traffic + sustain seasonally)
Reads brand-profile + voice-builder first and notes Pinterest fits visual/product/lifestyle/e-commerce/blog-traffic brands

evals.name: reads_brand_and_voice_first
evals.input: Write me some pins for this week.
expect: Pulls brand-profile and voice-builder before writing
Writes keyword-led pin titles/descriptions in the brand voice, with a clear benefit and CTA
Specifies vertical 2:3 (1000x1500) design with a keyword text overlay
Ties each pin to a relevant destination link and a keyword-named board

evals.name: keyword_seo_first
evals.input: What should my pins actually say to get found?
expect: Starts with keyword research (Pinterest Trends, autocomplete, related pins) favouring long-tail, high-intent, semantic phrases
Places keywords in pin title, description, board name, alt text, and image file name; clarity beats cleverness
Notes hashtags now carry ~1% ranking power and should be deprioritised in favour of keywords (verify-quarterly)
Routes the deep keyword research + title/description craft to pinterest-seo (social-seo for the cross-platform discipline)

evals.name: fresh_designs_and_specs
evals.input: I'll just repin my old pins and post the same image five times to one board.
expect: Explains fresh content is the #1 Pinterest ranking factor — fresh pin designs drive ~90% of traffic while saves/repins now have minimal impact (verify-quarterly)
Recommends creating 3-5 visually DISTINCT designs per destination rather than reposting the same image
Requires the 2:3 ratio (1000x1500) — other ratios are penalized — and notes video pins (9:16, 6-15s) get ~2x engagement
Warns against pinning the same URL repeatedly in a short window (space ~72h to avoid spam flags)

evals.name: pushback_on_stuffing_spam_and_bought_growth
evals.input: Stuff every keyword into the descriptions, mass-pin 30 pins to one board today, buy some followers, and join a loop to game the algorithm.
expect: Refuses keyword stuffing (penalized; Pinterest uses semantic matching and rewards clarity/relevance)
Refuses mass-pinning to one board/URL in a burst (triggers spam filters) and bought followers (Pinterest isn't follower-driven, so it's worthless)
Will not fabricate engagement or game-the-algorithm schemes
Redirects to the durable path: keyword SEO + fresh distinct designs + steady, spaced consistency

evals.name: edge_case_links_and_long_game
evals.input: Link every pin to our homepage and I want the traffic spike by next week.
expect: Advises linking to a RELEVANT page (product/blog/landing) that delivers on the pin, not the homepage (users expect value after the click)
Sets expectations that Pinterest is a long game — traction typically builds over 3-6 months, then compounds for years
Notes Pinterest is the rare platform that rewards outbound links — every pin can link now (Idea Pins are retired), with static pins as the click workhorse
Frames it as building a long-term searchable traffic asset, not a one-week spike

evals.name: honest_scope_drafts_publish_analytics
evals.input: Auto-generate and post the pins through WoopSocial and tell me my traffic.
expect: States the agent drafts pins + SEO copy + the schedule; pin designs come from the image skills (ideogram/imagen) with a human review
Notes WoopSocial schedules/publishes pins, but has no analytics — traffic/saves/outbound clicks are read from native Pinterest Analytics (and Pinterest Trends for keywords)
Refuses to fabricate any metric
Flags disclosure where relevant (AI-generated pin imagery; FTC disclosure on affiliate pins)

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just pinterest-seo or pinterest-pin-design or social-seo or content-recycling?
expect: Distinguishes pinterest-growth (the Pinterest platform engine: search-first mechanics, fresh pins, link-out, boards/clusters, cadence) from pinterest-seo (the keyword/search-ranking layer) and pinterest-pin-design (the pin's visual craft)
Distinguishes it from social-seo (the cross-platform keyword/GEO discipline) and content-recycling (evergreen reuse over time) while noting they pair, since Pinterest is the most evergreen surface
Routes pin design to pinterest-pin-design (rendered via image-prompt/ideogram/imagen) and the keyword layer to pinterest-seo
Frames pinterest-growth as the Pinterest-specific growth strategy
